# TgWitness

> Open-source Telegram investigation workspace. Export chats and whole accounts, keep every observed edit and deletion notice, follow people across chats, and hand over signed archives that recipients verify on their own computers.

TgWitness runs on the operator's computer or server and is maintained by PhishDestroy under the MIT License. The guided installer includes Python and checks release signatures; GitHub releases, source installation and Docker are also available.

## Key facts

- Live observation saves each version of a message and keeps its text after a deletion notice; history export reads the accessible history of selected chats or the whole account.
- Every record is signed and hash-chained. Recipients verify an archive offline with the bundled verifier, a separately received key fingerprint and retained checkpoints; independent witnesses add checkpoints, and RFC 3161 and OpenTimestamps add external time.
- Messages arrive over the account's authenticated MTProto session and are signed on receipt. GitHub Actions capture and Phala Intel TDX deployments add attestation of the collector that received them.
- Published measurements: 56,329 messages in two fresh exports on 6 November 2026 at 142.983 and 160.531 messages/second; 48 verified archives with 3,598,381 records in the public-history qualification.
- Investigation tools: people profiles across chats, watchlists over text, QR codes and OCR, wallet checks, Case Board, report studio and a BagIt court package with a Rule 902(13)/(14) template.
- Self-hosted with no telemetry: sessions and credentials live in an encrypted vault, and the panel listens on localhost.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/README.md): Overview, installation and the verification command.
- [Installation](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md): Installer, verify-first commands, Docker and updates.
- [Current capabilities](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md): Available workflows and qualification links.
- [Collection methods](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/COLLECTION-MODES.md): History, live observation, sharing and capture paths.
- [Accounts](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/ACCOUNTS.md): Authorization and supported session formats.
- [Project website](https://phishdestroy.github.io/TgWitness/): Illustrated guides and a browser demo with fictional records.

## Evidence and verification

- [Evidence format](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/EVIDENCE.md): Signed journal, archive formats, verification paths and where the messages come from.
- [What the record establishes](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/FOR-THE-RECORD.md): Assurance steps and how to check them in five minutes.
- [Independent verification](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/TRUST.md): Trusted inputs for recipients.
- [Witness](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/WITNESS.md) and [timestamps](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/TIMESTAMP.md): External checkpoints and time.
- [GitHub Actions capture](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/SEALED-ACTIONS.md) and [Intel TDX](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/HIGH-ASSURANCE.md): Attested collection.
- [Validation record](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/VERIFICATION.md) and [public-history qualification](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/EXPORT-BENCHMARK-2026-11-06.md): Measurements with their revisions.

- [Investigation](https://github.com/phishdestroy/TgWitness/blob/main/docs/INVESTIGATION.md): Source-linked analysis, people, files and timelines.
